methods.candidate_workaround: Pass real directory roots to the search tool and express filename selection through explicit include filters such as -g patterns.
methods.failure_signature: A Windows recursive search received wildcard path arguments directly and returned invalid-path error 123 before producing an inventory.
methods.recurrence_guard: On Windows, never pass shell-style wildcard path components as directory arguments to rg; use concrete roots plus -g filters.
methods.rollback: Discard the failed inventory, retain the error as an operational negative, and rerun once with concrete roots and explicit filters.
methods.scope_boundary: Read-only local source inventory only; no source mutation, suite credit, or independent-reproduction credit.
methods.title: Windows directory-root search with explicit include filters
trigger_preconditions: A recursive text or file search is running under Windows PowerShell.
The intended selection is a filename pattern within one or more known directory roots.

methods.candidate_workaround: Search only concrete owner, scripts, and tests roots; express file selection with -g include filters and exclude inherited frozen-index paths whose historical labels are intentional.
methods.failure_signature: A staged stale-label wrapper repeated invalid-path error 123 because wildcard path components were again passed as search roots.
methods.recurrence_guard: Build compound rg audits from a concrete-root array and explicit -g filters; treat exit one as a zero-hit success only after checking the zero-line result.
methods.rollback: Discard the failed stale-label conclusion, retain the wrapper failure, and rerun the bounded audit once with concrete roots and explicit filters.
methods.scope_boundary: Read-only staged stale-label review only; inherited provenance labels remain intentional and no suite or independent-reproduction credit is earned.
methods.title: Compound staged stale-label audit with concrete roots
trigger_preconditions: A staged audit searches owner documents plus phase-local scripts and tests.
Different file classes require include and exclusion filters without broad workspace enumeration.

methods.candidate_workaround: Retain the missing dependency as a negative, perform no installation, and use a pure structural output/ratio-budget refusal fixture that explicitly earns no decoder or RFC-conformance credit.
methods.failure_signature: A bounded import probe found that the optional Brotli module was unavailable in the existing environment.
methods.recurrence_guard: Probe optional modules once before implementation; when absent, do not install or repeatedly import them and downgrade the claimed evidence surface explicitly.
methods.rollback: Remove any dependency-specific path, keep the import failure, and preserve a no-decoder boundary around the structural fixture.
methods.scope_boundary: Owner-local synthetic format-budget evidence only; no decoding, user material, production, supply-chain, or exhaustive-security credit.
methods.title: Optional decoder dependency refusal with structural fallback
trigger_preconditions: A bounded format tribunal could use an optional decoder dependency.
The live phase forbids unrelated installation or environment widening.

methods.candidate_workaround: Read the concrete skill file directly, enumerate the concrete references directory, and use -g filters when recursive filename selection is needed.

methods.recurrence_guard: Reject every rg command containing a wildcard in a path argument; use concrete roots, directory enumeration, or explicit -g include filters.
methods.rollback: Discard the failed search result, retain error 123 as an operational negative, and rerun once against concrete paths.
methods.scope_boundary: Read-only local skill-reference discovery only; no repository-suite, source-authority, or independent-reproduction credit.

methods.candidate_workaround: Recompute the total from inherited, x1, synthetic, and x2 categories; update the builder and assertion together; rerun only the focused preflight.
methods.failure_signature: A focused x2 test expected the pre-recovery total after two later operational negatives had been retained.
methods.recurrence_guard: Before each focused test run, regenerate the retained-negative register after all newly recorded Method Flow failures and assert the category sum as well as the total.
methods.rollback: Retain the failed focused run with zero canonical credit, restore category-consistent accounting, and rerun the bounded preflight only.
methods.scope_boundary: Focused owner-local test recovery only; no canonical suite, replay, independent-reproduction, or assurance credit.
methods.title: Additive negative-total assertion synchronized with Method Flow

methods.candidate_workaround: Read the exact inherited final-validation-plan directly and use a concrete scripts root with -g only if supporting implementation lookup is still necessary.

methods.scope_boundary: Plan-only import and selection recovery; no repository test executed and no canonical, replay, or independent-reproduction credit.
